outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING OVER PARTS OF THE NORTHEAST AND MID-ATLANTIC. A FEW STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS ALSO MAY DEVELOP OVER THE CAROLINAS. FARTHER WEST...SOME SEVERE STORMS ARE POSSIBLE MAINLY FROM EASTERN COLORADO INTO CENTRAL KANSAS LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND TONIGHT.

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF THE CNTRL PLNS
sections.text: ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM THE CAROLINAS NEWD INTO THE NERN U.S.... ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM ERN CO INTO ERN KS/NRN OK...

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: PROGRESSIVE PATTERN WILL PERSIST ACROSS THE LWR 48...WITH THE MAIN BELT OF THE WLYS CONTINUING OVER THE NRN TIER OF STATES. FAIRLY POTENT SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW APPROACHING THE LWR GRT LKS WILL PIVOT E/SE INTO WRN QUE/NRN NY THIS EVE...AND CROSS THE LWR ST LAWRENCE VLY EARLY SAT...WHILE ASSUMING A NEGATIVE TILT. ATTENDANT SFC LOW WILL DEEPEN OVER SRN QUE TODAY/TNGT AS TRAILING COLD FRONT ACCELERATES ESEWD...REACHING AN ERN NY/CNTRL MD AXIS BY EARLY EVE. AT THE SAME TIME...LINGERING FRONT OVER THE LWR CHESAPEAKE BAY REGION SHOULD FURTHER WEAKEN...ALLOWING RICHER LOW-LVL MOISTURE TO SPREAD NE INTO SERN NY AND SRN/WRN NEW ENGLAND. FARTHER W...MODEST MID-LVL WLY FLOW WILL CONTINUE FROM THE FOUR CORNERS REGION INTO THE CNTRL PLNS BENEATH SRN STREAM JET. UPSLOPE FLOW WILL PERSIST N OF DIFFUSE W-E FRONT NOW STALLING OVER OK/NW TX...AND N OF LEE LOW EXPECTED TO EVOLVE LATER TODAY OVER NE NM AND THE NWRN TX PANHANDLE.

sections.title: NORTHEAST/MID-ATLANTIC TODAY INTO TNGT
sections.text: SEASONABLY STRONG 700-500 MB FLOW ALREADY PRESENT OVER PARTS OF THE NERN U.S. WILL FURTHER STRENGTHEN AND SPREAD E/NE INTO NEW ENGLAND LATER TODAY/TNGT AS GRT LKS TROUGH CONTINUES GENERALLY EWD. SFC/STREAMLINE ANALYSES SUGGEST THAT A CONFLUENCE AXIS IS BEGINNING TO EVOLVE THIS MORNING FROM ERN WV NWD INTO CNTRL NY...WELL E OF BOTH THE OHIO COLD FRONT AND WRN PA/NY CONVECTIVE BAND. AT THE SAME TIME...SFC AND SATELLITE PW DATA SHOW APPRECIABLE MOISTURE /DEWPOINTS IN THE UPR 60S F AND PW AROUND 1.5 INCHES/ SPREADING NWD FROM THE DELMARVA REGION ACROSS ERN PA AND NJ. CONTINUED SFC HEATING AND MOISTENING ALONG WITH MODERATE FORCING FOR ASCENT WITH UPR TROUGH SHOULD RESULT IN FAIRLY WIDESPREAD AFTN STORM DEVELOPMENT IN WEAKLY-CAPPED ENVIRONMENT FROM CNTRL/ERN NY SWD INTO MD-VA. DEVELOPMENT MAY BE MOST CONCENTRATED ALONG THE CONFLUENCE AXIS AND...POSSIBLY...ON ERN EDGE OF WRN PA/NY CONVECTIVE BAND. AMPLE /40+ KT/ WSWLY DEEP SHEAR WILL BE PRESENT FOR SUSTAINED STORMS/SUPERCELLS...BUT STORM MODE WILL BE COMPLEX GIVEN MULTIPLE SOURCES OF LOW-LVL UPLIFT AND WEAK CINH. WITH TIME...OVERALL SET-UP SUGGESTS LIKELY EVOLUTION INTO A FAIRLY EXTENSIVE NE/SW SQLN...WITH THE MOST PROGRESSIVE/LONG-LIVED

sections.title: CNTRL HIGH PLNS ESEWD LATE THIS AFTN/TNGT
sections.text: CONSIDERABLE CLOUD COVER IN WAKE OF OVNGT STORMS WILL LIMIT SFC HEATING OVER THE CNTRL HIGH PLNS AND ADJACENT FOOTHILLS TODAY...DOWNSTREAM FROM FOUR CORNERS/LWR CO VLY UPR IMPULSE AND N OF STALLED FRONT. NEVERTHELESS...COMBINATION OF PERSISTENT MOIST/ESELY UPSLOPE FLOW AND WEAK HEIGHT FALLS WITH APPROACHING UPR SYSTEM LIKELY WILL SUPPORT FAIRLY WIDESPREAD AFTN/EVE STORMS OVER S CNTRL/SE CO. OTHER STORMS MAY FORM ALONG RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARY SEGMENTS/DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ZONES ESEWD INTO KS. MARGINALLY SVR HAIL AND LOCALLY DMGG GUSTS MAY ACCOMPANY SOME STORMS. A TORNADO OR TWO ALSO CANNOT BE RULED OUT GIVEN DEGREE OF MOISTURE /PW AOA 1.5 INCHES/ AND SOME DEGREE OF LOW-LVL DIRECTIONAL SHEAR. BUT MODEST MEAN FLOW...WEAK LOW- TO MID-LVL LAPSE RATES...AND COMPLEX STORM MODES SHOULD LIMIT STRENGTH/PERSISTENCE OF INDIVIDUAL UPDRAFTS...AND THE OVERALL SVR RISK. THE STORMS SHOULD MERGE INTO A SIZABLE ESE OR SE-MOVING MCS OVER KS TNGT/EARLY SAT...WITH A CONTINUING RISK FOR OCCASIONAL LOCALLY DMGG GUSTS.

sections.title: CAROLINAS THIS AFTN
sections.text: HAVE MAINTAINED EXISTING MRGL SVR RISK ACROSS S CNTRL VA AND CNTRL PORTIONS OF THE CAROLINAS...WHERE MODERATE INSTABILITY WILL DEVELOP IN WAKE OF OFFSHORE CONVECTIVE COMPLEX. MODEST DEEP SHEAR AND FORCING FOR ASCENT SHOULD...HOWEVER...LIMIT STORM STRENGTH/LONGEVITY. ..CORFIDI/GRAMS.. 07/01/2016

sections.title: THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS THE CNTRL PLAINS
sections.text: ...SUMMARY... SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING OVER PARTS OF THE NORTHEAST AND MID-ATLANTIC. FARTHER WEST...ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE POSSIBLE MAINLY FROM EASTERN COLORADO INTO CENTRAL KANSAS LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND TONIGHT.

sections.title: CNTRL PLAINS - REMOVED SLIGHT RISK
sections.text: EXTENSIVE CLOUDS REMAIN OVER THE AREA ALTHOUGH AREAS OF HEATING WERE OCCURRING ESPECIALLY FROM SERN CO INTO THE OK/TX PANHANDLES. A RELATIVELY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER EXISTS AREA-WIDE AND A LOW-LEVEL JET WILL INCREASE OUT OF THE S THIS EVENING. HOWEVER...TEMPERATURES ALOFT REMAIN RELATIVELY WARM WITH LITTLE MID OR HIGH LEVEL FLOW. AN ISOLATED SUPERCELL WITH HAIL OR BRIEF TORNADO APPEARS MOST LIKELY OVER SERN CO...AND POSSIBLY EXTENDING INTO THE OK/TX PANHANDLE NEAR OUTFLOW BOUNDARY LATE THIS AFTERNOON. BY THIS EVENING...STORMS WILL BECOME MORE NUMEROUS DUE TO THE INCREASING WARM ADVECTION AND LIFT NEAR THE WARM FRONT BUT SLOW-MOVING HEAVY RAIN STORMS APPEAR MOST PROBABLE WITH ONLY ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS OR MARGINAL HAIL EXPECTED.

sections.title: CAROLINAS - REMOVED MARGINAL RISK
sections.text: STRONGER MID TO UPPER LEVEL FLOW CURRENTLY EXISTS ROUGHLY N OF THE VA/NC BORDER IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE UPPER TROUGH WITH MUCH WEAKER WIND FIELDS SWD INTO SC. HERE...MIDLEVEL TEMPERATURES ARE ALSO WARM...AND STORMS ACROSS THE ERN CAROLINAS HAVE BEEN WEAK AND ARE ALSO FIGHTING DRY AIR ALOFT. AS A RESULT...HAVE REDUCED SEVERE PROBABILITIES ACROSS THIS AREA.

sections.title: NERN STATES
sections.text: STORMS ARE EVOLVING AS DESCRIBED IN THE PREVIOUS OUTLOOK WITH SUPERCELLS NOW OVER PARTS OF ERN NY. HAIL...WIND...AND ISOLATED TORNADOES WILL CONTINUE TO BE POSSIBLE THROUGH EARLY EVENING AS WIND FIELDS CONTINUE TO INCREASE...SUPPORTING SEVERE STORMS. ..JEWELL.. 07/01/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1129 AM CDT FRI JUL 01 2016/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD UNDERGO A GRADUAL INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THROUGH THE EARLY AFTERNOON WITH A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND...LARGE HAIL AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES. A WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED BY 18Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SHOWERS AND A FEW THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING FROM ERN NY INTO ERN PA WITHIN A ZONE OF PRE-FRONTAL CONFLUENCE AND WEAKENING CONVECTIVE INHIBITION. ACTIVITY SHOULD CONTINUE A GRADUAL INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY PROMOTED BY BOUNDARY LAYER WARMING AND CORRIDOR OF DEEP ASCENT DOWNSTREAM FROM PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH. OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SHOWS MLCAPE HAS INCREASED TO BETWEEN 500-1500 J/KG...AND FURTHER DESTABILIZATION WILL OCCUR AS THE SFC-LAYER WARMS. A BELT OF 40 KT WLY MID-LEVEL WINDS ACCOMPANYING THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS CONTRIBUTING TO UP TO 40 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR WHICH SUGGESTS SOME STORMS WILL DEVELOP UPDRAFT ROTATION. MIXED STORM MODES WITH BOTH MULTICELL AND SOME SUPERCELL STRUCTURES ARE EXPECTED AS ACTIVITY DEVELOPS EWD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL/WIND AND A BRIEF TORNADO WILL BE POSSIBLE INTO THIS EVENING AS STORMS DEVELOP ALONG THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND GRADUALLY SPREAD EAST. OVERALL SETUP MAY REMAIN TOO MARGINAL FOR A WW...BUT TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WIDELY SCATTERED CONVECTION HAS RECENTLY INTENSIFIED ALONG THE LEE OF THE SOUTHERN ROCKIES FROM DOUGLAS TO LAS ANIMAS COUNTIES IN CO. PRIMARY HAZARD WITH THIS INITIAL ACTIVITY SHOULD BE SEVERE HAIL GIVEN MODEST DEEP SHEAR PER FTG/PUX VWP DATA AND SEMI-DISCRETE MODE. GREATER BUOYANCY IS CONFINED DOWNSTREAM OF THIS CONVECTION ALONG THE DIFFUSE QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT ARCING SOUTHEAST INTO THE OK/TX PANHANDLES...WHERE SURFACE TEMPERATURES HAVE WARMED THROUGH THE 80S AMID MIDDLE 60S SURFACE DEW POINTS. AS STORMS GRADUALLY SPREAD INTO THIS MORE BUOYANT AIR MASS...STRONG TO SEVERE INTENSITY SHOULD BE MAINTAINED OVER SOUTHEAST CO AND EVENTUALLY SOUTHWEST KS WITH THE LLJ STRENGTHENING THIS EVENING. ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND A BRIEF TORNADO WILL BE POSSIBLE IN ADDITION TO HAIL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: IT IS NOT CLEAR THAT AN ADDITIONAL WATCH WILL BE NEEDED EAST OF TORNADO WATCH 313...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR THIS POSSIBILITY DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT CONTINUES TO SPREAD INTO/THROUGH THE HUDSON VALLEY AND NORTHERN MID ATLANTIC COAST REGION. THIS INCLUDES A COUPLE OF ISOLATED SUPERCELL STRUCTURES ACROSS THE HUDSON VALLEY...WHERE 850 MB FLOW REMAINS SOUTHERLY AND MODEST IN STRENGTH BENEATH 40-50 KT WESTERLY 500 MB FLOW. ACTIVITY APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN AIDED BY AN INITIAL WAVE OF LARGE-SCALE ASCENT WHICH WILL CONTINUE TO OVERSPREAD WESTERN/SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND THROUGH 23-00Z. A POCKET OF DRIER...MORE DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER AIR...WITH WEAK TO NEGLIGIBLE CAPE...PERSISTS ACROSS MUCH OF NORTHERN/CENTRAL VERMONT AND NEW HAMPSHIRE...WHICH PROBABLY WILL MITIGATE SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL ACROSS THAT AREA. AT THE SAME TIME...COOLER MARINE LAYER AIR MAY ALSO MITIGATE SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL ACROSS MUCH OF LONG ISLAND AND SOUTHEAST NEW ENGLAND. HOWEVER...THE AIR MASS ACROSS MUCH OF CONNECTICUT...WESTERN AND CENTRAL MASSACHUSETTS INTO SOUTHERN VERMONT AND NEW HAMPSHIRE MAY MAINTAIN UPSTREAM STORMS SPREADING EASTWARD...AND PERHAPS SUPPORT NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT INTO EARLY EVENING. FARTHER UPSTREAM...WEAK TO MODEST BOUNDARY LAYER INSTABILITY LINGERS TO THE WEST OF AREAS BEING CLEARED FROM THE TORNADO WATCH...ACROSS PARTS OF NORTH CENTRAL PENNSYLVANIA INTO CENTRAL NEW YORK. AS ANOTHER WAVE OF LARGE-SCALE ASCENT OVERSPREADS THIS REGION THROUGH EARLY EVENING...ADDITIONAL STRONG STORM DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE. HOWEVER...LOW-LEVEL WIND FIELDS ACROSS THIS REGION ARE NOW VEERED...AND LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS APPEAR LESS FAVORABLE FOR TORNADOES. HOWEVER...IT MAY NOT BE OUT OF THE QUESTION THAT ONE OR TWO THESE STORMS COULD BECOME CAPABLE OF PRODUCING MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND/OR LOCALIZED STRONG SURFACE GUSTS. ..KERR.. 07/01/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE INTENSIFICATION OF AT LEAST A FEW STORMS ACROSS THE WASHINGTON D.C...BALTIMORE AND PHILADELPHIA AREAS APPEARS POSSIBLE THROUGH 23-00Z. SOME MAY BECOME CAPABLE OF POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT SPREADING OFF THE BLUE RIDGE MOUNTAINS IS NOW INCREASING IN A CLUSTER NEAR AND TO THE SOUTHWEST OF THE WASHINGTON D.C. AREA. MORE WIDELY SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE ALSO IN THE PROCESS OF DEVELOPING/STRENGTHENING WITHIN THE PRE-FRONTAL LEE SURFACE TROUGH ACROSS THE WASHINGTON/BALTIMORE AREAS...NORTHWARD TOWARD THE PHILADELPHIA METRO AREA. THIS IS OCCURRING IN THE PRESENCE OF PEAK AFTERNOON BOUNDARY LAYER INSTABILITY...WHICH NOW APPEARS CHARACTERIZED BY CAPE OF 1500 TO 2000 J/KG...ALONG THE SURFACE TROUGH AXIS. ALTHOUGH LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS GENERALLY LIGHT AND WESTERLY...DEEP LAYER SHEAR BENEATH 40+ KT WESTERLY 500 MB FLOW IS STRONG...AND PROBABLY WILL CONTRIBUTE TO FURTHER INTENSIFICATION AND ORGANIZATION OF STORMS THROUGH 23-00Z. POTENTIALLY DAMAGING SURFACE GUSTS WILL BECOME POSSIBLE IN STRONGEST STORMS...ALONG WITH A RISK FOR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. ..KERR.. 07/01/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN INTENSITY DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS OVER THE AREA...WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS...SEVERE HAIL...AND A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO...BUT THE STORMS SHOULD REMAIN ISOLATED ENOUGH IN THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO PRECLUDING THE NEED FOR A WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG SURFACE HEATING OF A RELATIVELY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER IN THE WAKE OF MORNING CLOUDS/PRECIPITATION...AND WEAK FORCING FOR ASCENT AHEAD OF A BROAD MID-LEVEL PERTURBATION APPROACHING THE AREA...ARE SUPPORTING THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IN THE VICINITY OF A WEAK FRONTAL BOUNDARY DRAPED NW-SE ACROSS THE AREA. A NARROW CORRIDOR OF 2000-2500 J/KG OF MLCAPE PARALLELS THE FRONT...AND STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES IN THIS CORRIDOR MAY SUPPORT SEVERE WIND GUSTS...ESPECIALLY WHERE TEMPERATURES HAVE WARMED TO THE MID TO UPPER 80S AMIDST DEWPOINTS LOW TO MID 60S OVER THE OKLAHOMA AND NORTHERN TEXAS PANHANDLES. A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO IS POSSIBLE AS LIFTING CONDENSATION LEVELS ARE RELATIVELY LOW FOR THE AREA...1000-1500 M AGL...ESPECIALLY WHERE BACKED LOW-LEVEL FLOW PERSISTS ALONG AND A LITTLE NORTH OF THE FRONT. THE BACKED NEAR-SURFACE FLOW IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST AND STRENGTHEN WITH TIME...WHICH WILL BE CONTRIBUTING TO LARGER 0-3 KM HODOGRAPH CURVATURE AS THE 850-700 MB FLOW RESPONDS TO THE PERTURBATION APPROACHING THE AREA. ALTHOUGH MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND DEEP-LAYER SHEAR ARE RELATIVELY WEAK...THIS INCREASING HODOGRAPH CURVATURE SHOULD SUPPORT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WITH SEVERE HAIL IN THE MORE PERSISTENTLY ROTATING STORMS. STORM COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN LOW IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS PRECLUDING THE NEED FOR A WATCH. HOWEVER THE AREA WILL BE MONITORED FOR POTENTIAL INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE/ORGANIZATION THAT COULD INCREASE THE CHANCES FOR A WATCH LATER IN THE EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS CROSSING PORTIONS OF CNTRL/SRN AZ THROUGH THE LATE AFTERNOON / EARLY EVENING HOURS MAY PRODUCE LOCALLY STRONG TO SVR WIND GUSTS. HOWEVER...WW ISSUANCE IS NOT NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ASCENT RELATED TO A CONVECTIVELY ENHANCED MID-LEVEL PERTURBATION MOVING ACROSS PARTS OF WRN AZ...COUPLED WITH LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH BROAD MID-LEVEL CYCLONIC FLOW...CONTINUE SUPPORTING AN ENVIRONMENT FAVORABLE FOR TSTM DEVELOPMENT. OROGRAPHIC CIRCULATIONS ALONG THE MOGOLLON RIM...AND MESOSCALE LIFT ALONG AN ENE/WSW-ORIENTED CONVERGENCE AXIS EXTENDING FROM SE OF PRESCOTT AZ TO E OF BLYTHE CA WILL REMAIN PRINCIPAL FOCI FOR ADDITIONAL CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS A RELATIVELY MOIST...UNSTABLE...AND WEAKLY CAPPED ENVIRONMENT EXISTS ACROSS THE REGION. MORE ISOLATED CONVECTION WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP FARTHER E OVER THE DESERT FLOOR. SEASONABLY MOIST BOUNDARY-LAYER CONDITIONS MARKED BY SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE MIDDLE 60S TO AROUND 70F ARE SUPPORTING AROUND 1000-2000 J/KG OF MLCAPE OWING TO WIDESPREAD INSOLATION. THIS WILL SUPPORT A FEW VIGOROUS UPDRAFTS. THE PHOENIX VWP IS SAMPLING AROUND 25-35 KT OF MID-LEVEL FLOW OFFERING SUFFICIENT DEEP SHEAR FOR MULTICELL CLUSTERS WITH LOCALLY STRONG TO SVR WIND GUSTS. THIS WILL BE AIDED BY DIURNALLY ENHANCED DEEP MIXING FACILITATING DOWNDRAFT ACCELERATIONS OWING TO SUB-CLOUD EVAPORATION. TSTMS DEVELOPING ACROSS THE REGION HAVE ALREADY SHOWN SIGNS OF WEAK MESO-BETA-SCALE ORGANIZATION...AND THIS AFFIRMS SOME SVR-WIND RISK EXISTING AS COLD POOLS LOCALLY AMALGAMATE. THE RISK FOR BLOWING DUST SUBSTANTIALLY REDUCING VISIBILITY WILL ALSO EXIST. HOWEVER...MODEST LARGE-SCALE ASCENT AND MODEST MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL TEND TO LIMIT THE OVERALL SVR RISK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS MAY CONTINUE WITH CONVECTION SPREADING ACROSS THE STATE BORDER INTO WESTERN MAINE THROUGH 02-03Z. IT IS NOT CLEAR THAT ANOTHER WATCH IS NEEDED...HOWEVER.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MODEST STRENGTHENING OF SOUTHERLY LOW-LEVEL FLOW WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR OF A DEVELOPING SURFACE LOW NOW BEGINNING TO SHIFT INTO SOUTHERN QUEBEC...NEAR/NORTH OF THE ST. LAWRENCE VALLEY...HAS CONTRIBUTED TO PRE-FRONTAL MOISTENING ACROSS MUCH SOUTHERN/WESTERN NEW ENGLAND THE PAST COUPLE OF HOURS. BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTENING ACROSS CENTRAL/NORTHERN NEW HAMPSHIRE HAS BEEN OFFSET BY CONSIDERABLE COOLING OF TEMPERATURES...BUT OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS STILL SUGGESTS THAT AT LEAST SOME BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATION HAS OCCURRED. THIS HAS BEEN SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT SOME RECENT INTENSIFICATION OF A SMALL EVOLVING CONVECTIVE SYSTEM NEAR THE INTERSTATE 93 CORRIDOR NORTH OF CONCORD. IN THE PRESENCE OF FAVORABLE LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION...MOMENTUM/SHEAR ASSOCIATED STRENGTHENING SOUTHWESTERLY DEEP LAYER MEAN FLOW /TO AROUND OR IN EXCESS OF 40 KT/ PROVIDE AT LEAST SOME POTENTIAL FOR A CONTINUING RISK FOR POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. DUE TO THE MARGINAL NATURE OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATION AHEAD OF ACTIVITY...IT REMAINS UNCERTAIN HOW MUCH LONGER...BUT PERHAPS AT LEAST ACROSS THE STATE BORDER INTO PARTS OF WESTERN MAINE THROUGH 02-03Z. THIS COULD IMPACT AUBURN/LEWISTON...BUT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN WELL TO THE NORTHWEST OF THE PORTLAND AREA. ..KERR.. 07/02/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE WIND GUST AND BRIEF TORNADO EMBEDDED WITHIN A DEVELOPING QUASI-LINEAR CONVECTIVE SYSTEM ARE POSSIBLE IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS...BUT THE THREAT IS ISOLATED AND IS NOT EXPECTED TO REQUIRE A WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL QUASI-LINEAR CONVECTIVE SYSTEM CURRENTLY OVER BACA AND PROWERS COUNTIES IN COLORADO AND EXTENDING INTO CIMARRON COUNTY OKLAHOMA IS MOVING SLOWLY EASTWARD UNDER RELATIVELY WEAK MEAN MID-LEVEL FLOW PER REGIONAL 00Z SOUNDINGS. LINEAR ORGANIZATION...WEAK MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES OF ONLY 6-6.5 C/KM AND WEAKENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD PRECLUDE MOST OF THE SEVERE WIND AND HAIL THREAT THIS EVENING. HOWEVER...PERSISTENCE OF LOW-LEVEL EASTERLIES AND ENLARGING LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS UNDER A STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL JET AND SOUTHWESTERLY 700 MB FLOW HAS INCREASED THE EFFECTIVE STORM-RELATIVE HELICITY TO 300-400 M2/S2 OVER MUCH OF THE AREA...INCLUDING 0-1 KM SHEAR INCREASING TO OVER 20 KT. THIS ENHANCEMENT IN LOW-LEVEL SHEAR OVERLAPS WITH MLCAPE OF 1000-1500 J/KG...WHICH SHOULD BE MAINTAINED UNDER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE INFLUX FROM THE SOUTHEAST.
